tagline: Push-to-talk over cellular (PoC) solutions for enterprise and government
hero_kpi_rationale: Revenue serves as the primary performance indicator for this modest-sized technology company, reflecting market adoption of PoC solutions among government and commercial customers.

kpis.name: Total Revenue
kpis.explanation: Money earned from the sale of products and services during the year.
kpis.description: Revenue has increased due to broader adoption of PoC solutions among government and commercial customers.
kpis.signal: Double-digit growth despite a demanding market.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Percentage of revenue remaining after deducting direct production costs.
kpis.description: Gross margin improves due to better manufacturing cost management and a more profitable product mix.

kpis.name: Operating Margin
kpis.explanation: Profit achieved after deducting all operating expenses.
kpis.description: Operating margin increases due to cost savings and stabilization of fixed expenses.

kpis.name: R&D Investments (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue invested in research and development.
kpis.description: The company maintains a moderate level of R&D investment, focused on enhancing existing products.
kpis.signal: Slight reduction in R&D spending despite ongoing innovation.

kpis.name: Capital Expenditures
kpis.explanation: Spending to acquire or upgrade physical assets.
kpis.description: Capex remains moderate, reflecting a targeted investment strategy in production tools and software.

kpis.name: Total Headcount
kpis.explanation: Total number of people employed by the company.
kpis.description: Headcount increases slightly to strengthen sales and technical teams.
kpis.signal: Slight headcount growth to support operations.

risks.title: Dependence on distribution partners
risks.summary: Siyata relies heavily on its channel partners to generate the majority of its revenues. The loss or slowdown of these partners could severely impact sales and growth.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in a central position in the 10-K, with strong language ("substantial majority of our revenues"). The dependence is structural and recurring, reinforcing its severity. The Industrial category is strategic for the business.

risks.title: Competition in the telecom industry
risks.summary: Siyata operates in a highly competitive technology sector, where new entrants or innovations can quickly threaten its market share and ability to innovate.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is explicitly cited with high-intensity language ("competitive industry, which may become more competitive"). It is repeated in key factors, indicating a stable but critical trend.

risks.title: Product defects and reputation
risks.summary: Defects in Siyata devices could lead to loss of sales, market rejection, and serious harm to the brand's reputation, adversely affecting long-term growth.
risks.score_rationale: High placement in the text, strong language ("loss of sales, delay in market acceptance, injury to our reputation"). Recurring risk directly tied to product technology quality.

risks.title: Rapid technological change
risks.summary: The industry evolves rapidly, and Siyata risks failing to meet user needs if it cannot continuously innovate, threatening its market relevance.
risks.score_rationale: Alarming language ("may not be able to continue to develop solutions"), key placement in business risks. Implicit upward trend with accelerating technology. Technology category critical for innovation.

risks.title: Cyber threats to IT systems
risks.summary: A cyberattack on Siyata's or its partners' IT systems could disrupt operations, harm sales, and result in significant financial losses.
risks.score_rationale: Mentioned in a critical operational context (IT systems, partners, suppliers), with direct impact on sales and results. Serious tone, stable but concerning trend.

risks.title: Dependence on third-party components
risks.summary: Siyata depends on third-party suppliers for key components. Any supply disruption could delay deliveries and reduce sales, affecting profitability.
risks.score_rationale: Important position in operational risks, strong language ("delay shipment", "reduce our sales"). Structural and recurring risk, linked to critical supply chain.

risks.title: Data regulation and privacy
risks.summary: Siyata is subject to strict data protection regulations. Non-compliance could result in penalties, high costs, and loss of trust.
risks.score_rationale: Explicit mention of strict privacy and data security laws. Concerned tone, high placement. Upward trend with global regulatory tightening.

risks.title: Intellectual property protection
risks.summary: If Siyata fails to protect its patents and innovations, it could lose its competitive edge against players with stronger intellectual property resources.
risks.score_rationale: Strong language ("competitive position may be harmed"), key placement in business risks. Risk increasing with technological innovation. Technology category central to company value.

events.title: Core AI Holdings announces divestiture of Siyata Mobile, subsidiaries
events.body: Core AI Holdings (CHAI) announced that it has simultaneously signed and closed a definitive agreement to divest Siyata Mobile (SYTA) and its subsidiaries. This transaction is effective immediately and represents a completed strategic action
